title: Record consent
purpose: Record a participant's consent decision on a form version, as a first consent or a re-consent.

sections.title: How the form works
paragraphs: Choose the participant, the study and the form version. The form's scope categories appear under Answers per category. If you change the form version, saving shows the new version's categories to answer before anything is recorded. Opened from a consent page, the participant and study are filled in.

The newest record governs all of the participant's material in the study, including material collected under an earlier version. If the consent is withdrawn, the new record is kept but the status stays Withdrawn until another manager reinstates the consent.

items.label: Participant
items.description: Required. The coded identifier, e.g. P-000123; it must exist in the specimen catalogues. Never a name or record number.

items.label: Consent form version
items.description: Required. Active versions of the study.

items.label: Decision
items.description: Consented or Refused. Consented: every category the form asks must be answered Permitted or Refused. Refused: the participant refused the whole form; leave the categories unanswered.

items.label: Expires on
items.description: Optional; not before the decision. After it the gate blocks distribution.

items.label: Who decided, How it was documented
items.description: Required choices as recorded on the original.

items.label: Answers per category
items.description: Permitted or Refused for each category the form asks. A category the form does not ask is not addressed and does not permit a use.

items.label: Where the original is filed
items.description: Optional binder, cabinet or system reference. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Restrictions
items.description: Optional, up to 2,000 characters, shown to reviewers, allocators and pickers and never interpreted. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept with the record. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

After saving you are taken to the consent. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
The software stores what the filed consent says; it does not judge whether a consent is adequate.
